events.title: Agromatic Was Supposed to Be a Chill Automation Game. Then a War Started.
events.summary: The game on the store page today is not the game I set out to make. I want to walk through how that happened, because every step along the way was smaller than the result makes it look.THE ORIGINAL PLANA relaxing automation game for people who like automation games but bounce off the complexity. No pressure, no fail state. Place things down, hire people, watch the operation grow. Progression was supposed to end at the research facility.Then the finish line moved. events.title: Power Grid & Quality of Life Update
events.summary: It has been a long time since the last update, and I have been busy preparing the next big set of additions. This one brings a lot of quality of life features, much more precise control over your logistics, and a brand new progression layer: the Power Grid. I did not keep proper notes while working, so a lot of the smaller changes will not be mentioned here. events.title: The Visual Overhaul Update
events.summary: This is one of the biggest updates we've made to Agromatic so far.Over the past months, we've been reading your feedback and listening to what you wished the game looked and felt like. That feedback pushed us to do something we knew would take serious effort but would be worth it: rebuild the visuals from the ground up.Before:After:Every tile, every object, every worker, every item — redrawn.
